how_to_verify: Every claim lists evidence files plus an exact command or API sequence. Commands marked [tests] run with `python -m pytest <path> -q` from vyapaar-kavach/. Commands marked [server] need: 1) python -m services.api.fixtures.seed --reset  2) uvicorn services.api.app.main:app --port 8000. Research claims additionally require '../dataset1 (1).pt' and '../GAT_Model_Final (2).pt' (paths in .env.example).

claims.claim: Seeded demo users authenticate; role and tenant are resolved server-side from memberships; bad passwords are rejected with 401.
claims.expected_result: 200 on login; /v1/auth/me returns role owner, tenant tnt_demo01, environment DEMO_LOCAL; wrong password -> 401

claims.claim: Fixture F1 (Rs 3,000 succeeded payment + Rs 500 PENDING refund) yields action CHECK_EXISTING_REFUND with reason REFUND_ALREADY_PENDING and no execution.
Fixture F2 (refund outcome UNKNOWN after timeout) keeps exposure visible: REFUND_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and missing fact current_refund_outcome; no replacement payment is suggested.
claims.expected_result: action=CHECK_EXISTING_REFUND, reason REFUND_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, current_refund_outcome in missing_facts

claims.claim: Fixture F3 (two identical Rs 799 payments, no reference) never auto-binds: case stays UNMATCHED, at least two candidates are listed, recommendation is DISAMBIGUATE_PAYMENT.
claims.expected_result: match_status=UNMATCHED; candidates include pay_mock_txn_799_a and pay_mock_txn_799_b; reason MULTIPLE_PAYMENT_MATCHES

claims.claim: Payment binding happens only via an explicit, tenant-scoped match request.
claims.expected_result: POST match -> match_status MATCHED with chosen payment_id; ambiguity reason code disappears

claims.claim: Provider outage is surfaced honestly: refresh returns HTTP 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, the payment keeps its last status, verification becomes STALE; after outage refresh succeeds.
claims.expected_result: 503 with code PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE; status stays SUCCEEDED; verification STALE; recovered to VERIFIED after outage_off

claims.claim: Duplicate provider events are acknowledged without repeating side effects (fingerprint dedup).
claims.expected_result: 2nd identical event -> duplicate=true; exactly one provider_events row

claims.claim: A delayed PENDING event never silently regresses a SUCCEEDED payment: status preserved, verification flagged CONFLICTED, observation retained.
Cross-tenant reads return 404 (existence is not leaked), enforced by server-side scoping on every object lookup.
claims.expected_result: 404 for a payment belonging to another tenant

claims.claim: Staff cannot resolve cases (owner-only); stale edits are rejected with 409 STALE_VERSION via the case version guard.
claims.expected_result: staff resolve -> 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE; owner resolve 200; repeat with old version -> 409 STALE_VERSION

claims.claim: Evidence exports trace to stored records: refund references appear, observations carry source labels, limitations section exists, and a SHA-256 digest is recorded.
claims.expected_result: 64-hex sha256; markdown contains REF-500-001 and Limitations; JSON observations include provider_mock source kinds

claims.claim: Refunds have no arbitrary destination field anywhere in the schema — supported refunds return to the original payment source by construction.
claims.verify_command: [server] python -c "from services.api.app.models import Refund; print([c.key for c in Refund.__table__.columns])"
claims.expected_result: no destination/account field in the column list

claims.claim: No execution path exists in this prototype: every recommendation carries execution_allowed=false; there is no endpoint that submits refunds.
claims.verify_command: [server] python -c "import re; src=open('services/api/app/policy.py',encoding='utf-8').read(); print('execution_allowed": False' in src)"
claims.expected_result: True; and no submit_refund route exists under services/api/app/api/routes

claims.claim: Research runs perform REAL checkpoint inference on held-out Elliptic2 graphs, persist dataset/checkpoint SHA-256 hashes, and report precision/recall/F1.
claims.expected_result: abstained=false; data_mode=ORIGINAL_DOMAIN_RESEARCH; 64-hex hashes; 32-example scores with metrics

claims.claim: Unsupported tasks (e.g. merchant-case scoring) abstain with an explicit reason — a model never fabricates a score.
Model performance is honestly reproduced: full 24,363-graph test set, threshold 0.79 locked on validation, F1=0.5558, PR-AUC=0.5906, with hashes in metrics.json.
claims.expected_result: recompute prints precision 0.6988 / recall 0.4614 / F1 0.5558 / PR-AUC 0.5906 (GPU or CPU)

claims.claim: Merchant records survive server restarts (SQL-backed persistence; jobs and observations are durable rows, not memory state).
claims.verify_command: [server] seed, create a case via API, stop uvicorn, restart, GET /v1/cases -> the case is still present
claims.expected_result: the created case persists with notes across a restart

claims.claim: Every screen and export is labelled Synthetic data / Mock provider; model output is presented only as original-domain research with an abstention policy.
claims.verify_command: [server] open any page -> persistent banner; POST /v1/cases/{id}/exports -> packet Limitations section
claims.expected_result: banner visible on every page; exports include limitations list
